einzeiler: An excerpt from the novel The Quiet Room by Terry Miles, followed by updates.
kurzfassung: An audio excerpt from the novel The Quiet Room introduces a tester arriving for a mysterious assignment in Seattle. Following the story, updates are provided regarding upcoming seasons of Tannis, The Rabbit's Podcast, and The Last Movie. Finally, details are shared about the publication of the new book.
stichpunkte: Terry Miles reads an excerpt from his new novel, The Quiet Room
The Quiet Room serves as a sequel to the novel Rabbits and releases on October 3rd
A tester arrives in Seattle to administer a mysterious Phase 4 test
The tester navigates a secure facility to meet an angry subject in a soundproof room
Terry Miles provides updates on upcoming seasons of Tannis
New seasons of The Rabbit's Podcast and The Last Movie are currently in production
All project information and updates can be found at TerryMiles.com

clips.hook: A tester arrives in the city for an assignment
clips.text: A woman steps out of a vehicle in an urban environment while preparing for a pending rain shower.
The traveler reflects on a short flight between major West Coast cities and the absence of beverage service.
